content: 1. Rifampin reduces the plasma levels and therapeutic effects of fostamatinib by inducing the metabolism of the drug through hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative medications. 2. Rifampin decreases the efficacy of fruquintinib by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 3. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of futibatinib by accelerating its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or select an alternative therapy. 4. The coadministration of futibatinib with drugs that are dual P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and strong CYP3A inducers may significantly reduce the efficacy of futibatinib. Avoid such combinations or use alternative treatments. 5. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of ganaxolone by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider increasing the ganaxolone dose, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose based on weight. 6. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of gepirone by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 7. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of gilteritinib, which is a substrate of both P-gp and CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 8. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of glasdegib by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers. 9. Rifampin significantly reduces the plasma levels and efficacy of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 10. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of hydrocortisone by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 11. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 12. Rifampin decreases the levels of ibrutinib by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes, leading to a ~10-fold reduction in plasma concentrations. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 13. Rifampin reduces the systemic exposure and efficacy of idelalisib by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 14. Rifampin decreases the plasma levels and effects of iloperidone by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 15. Rifampin significantly reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of indinavir by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. This combination is contraindicated. 16. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of infigratinib by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 17. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of irinotecan by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 18. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of irinotecan liposomal by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 19. Rifampin increases the toxicity of isoniazid by enhancing its metabolism to hepatotoxic metabolites. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 20. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of istradefylline by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 21. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of ivabradine by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 22. Rifampin significantly reduces the systemic exposure of ivacaftor (~9-fold) by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 23. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of ivosidenib by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 24. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of ixabepilone by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 25. Rifampin decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of ixazomib by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers. 26. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of lansoprazole by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 27. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of lapatinib by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 28. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of larotrectinib by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. If coadministration is unavoidable, double the larotrectinib dose and resume the prior dose after discontinuing the CYP3A4 inducer for 3-5 half-lives. 29. Rifampin increases the levels of lasmiditan by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 30. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of lefamulin by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A inducers unless the benefit outweighs the risks. 31. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of lemborexant by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 32. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of leniolisib by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 33. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of letermovir by inducing P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. Avoid coadministration with P-gp inducers. 34. Rifampin decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of lomitapide by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 35. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of lopinavir by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 36. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of loratadine by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 37. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of lovastatin by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 38. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration and efficacy of lumateperone by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 39. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of lurbinectedin by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 40. Rifampin decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of macimorelin by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration, as it may lead to false-positive test results. Discontinue strong CYP3A4 inducers and allow sufficient washout time before testing. 41. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of macitentan by inducing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 42. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of maraviroc by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 43. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of mavorixafor by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 44. Rifampin significantly reduces the plasma concentration of mestranol by inducing its metabolism, potentially leading to contraceptive failure. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 45. Rifampin lowers the levels and effects of methadone by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 46. Rifampin decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of methylprednisolone by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 47. Rifampin reduces the levels and effects of midazolam by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. 48. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration and therapeutic effect of midostaurin by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 49. Rifampin decreases the levels and effects of naldemedine by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 50. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of neratinib by inducing its metabolism via CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers.
